title: La Esperança
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At a boys' boarding school in Europe, admired model student Georges Saphir keeps everyone at a distance out of fear of being hurt. Misfit Robert sees through him without effort, and Georges fears that letting him close will bring a tragedy that proves those fears right (DMP blurb). Seven volumes, shoujo with a quiet boys' love thread.
life_message: A guarded heart has to risk being known to find real friendship and love.
